pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygons with high-frequency, jagged edge gradients. Patches on the upper neck and shoulder are significantly larger in surface area than the smaller, more compact patches on the lower flank and hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of thin, light-colored pathways with uniform pixel thickness. Junction nodes primarily consist of three-way and four-way intersections creating a complex tessellation.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Continuous 1D contour along the dorsal neck characterized by a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette against the sky, representing upright hair structure.
